title: 三维形体的表面积
summary: 网格每格堆叠若干单位立方体，求组合形体暴露在外的总表面积。
insight: 高度 h 的独立柱贡献 4h+2；与上方和左方相邻柱每重叠一层会遮住两个面，减去 2·min(height1,height2)。
pitfalls: 高度零的柱没有顶底面
每对相邻柱只处理一次
上下左右四面通过两方向邻接扣减即可

solutions.title: 柱体表面减共享面
solutions.idea: 逐格加入独立柱面积并扣除已扫描邻居重合面。
steps: 若 column>0，对左邻同样扣减；返回总和

code.java: class Solution { public int surfaceArea(int[][] grid){int answer=0;for(int r=0;r<grid.length;r++)for(int c=0;c<grid[0].length;c++){int height=grid[r][c];if(height>0)answer+=4*height+2;if(r>0)answer-=2*Math.min(height,grid[r-1][c]);if(c>0)answer-=2*Math.min(height,grid[r][c-1]);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun surfaceArea(grid:Array<IntArray>):Int{var answer=0;for(r in grid.indices)for(c in grid[0].indices){val height=grid[r][c];if(height>0)answer+=4*height+2;if(r>0)answer-=2*minOf(height,grid[r-1][c]);if(c>0)answer-=2*minOf(height,grid[r][c-1])};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int surfaceArea(vector<vector<int>>& grid){int answer=0;for(int r=0;r<(int)grid.size();++r)for(int c=0;c<(int)grid[0].size();++c){int height=grid[r][c];if(height)answer+=4*height+2;if(r)answer-=2*min(height,grid[r-1][c]);if(c)answer-=2*min(height,grid[r][c-1]);}return answer;} };
